items.title: Forensics: reconstruct every dated trade and chart example he posts and find what distinguishes them

forms.what: table of every dated example (instrument, minute, direction, stated entry / targets / reason) from text AND images; 1-min data around each
forms.result: 10 dated examples tabled (S1/S2 notes, dates hand-resolved: M4e days = 2021-07-20, 11-26, 12-13, 2022-01-07 matched on daily low+range; 1 is 2020, no minute data). 8 trade examples with data: +60 min mean +0.75% (7/8 > 0), +1 d +3.5% (7/8), median percentile vs all minutes of the same coin-month 87% (60 min) / 79% (1 d). Descriptive only: n=8, his own selected winners, not a test. His one 'stay out, not a bottom' example (2021-09-21 thin-volume low) went +6.9% next day (98th pct) = counterexample. Anchors set by rule were hand-checked bar by bar (L1-0323 08:57, N5-1110 14:13)

forms.what: feature vector at each example (about 25 features: fall, speed, volume decay, retrace of the first 1/2/3 min, taker share, trade count, location vs prior-day / week / POC, hour, trend, breadth, premium, OI) vs all similar moments: which unstated features are extreme in ALL his examples?
forms.result: daily family (4 M4e capitulation days vs 211 BTC down days <= -3%, 2021-02..2026-10, 15 features incl. author7 TSize): NO feature extreme in all 4 vs down days; vs all days only ret/dd5/dd20 (= 'a down day in a drawdown'). 'All buckets negative' is the norm, not the anomaly: 54% of >= -3% days have 7/7 negative, 77% >= 6; next-3d +0.51% (7/7) vs +0.55% (<7), up 58% vs 59%. Only the MAGNITUDE (min bucket delta share) can carry M4e: extreme only on 2021-11-26 (6th pct). Stay-out day 2021-09-21 had the fewest negative buckets (5, 6th pct) and still rallied. Minute examples (4, 3 different families) not pooled: too few per family. Exploration on full sample, not a test

forms.what: analog test: nearest neighbours of his examples in 2021-23 (never the examples themselves) -> what happened next, vs random moments with the same fall
forms.result: explore 2021-23, BTC/ETH/SOL: 56 analog down days (15 nearest per his 4 capitulation days, 13 features incl. TSize, +-5 d excluded) long 3 d: +79 bp vs matched same-coin same-ret-decile down days +74 bp, diff +6 bp (p 0.98), MDE 353 bp, ex-top3 -54 bp, 2022 -13 bp. Causality ok; null (400 coin-toss copies) +15 bp, sd 142 (first run with 20 copies read +67 bp = small-sample noise, not a bug). Verdict: his days' analogs = any down day of that size; no detectable extra edge (only effects > 3.5% could be seen)

forms.what: same for moments he says he would NOT trade
forms.result: explore 2021-23: 15 analog down days of his one stay-out day (2021-09-21 'issa fart, not a bottom'), long 3 d: +116 bp vs matched down days -250 bp, diff +366 bp (p 0.26, MDE 758): opposite sign to his claim but n=15 and only one source day, so uninformative. forms.result: gate passed in 01:47 session (robust.worst 2.00, WF min 1.94, DSR .98); live paper book built: kripto/ladder.py + kripto-ladder.service (started 2026-11-23 13:50 UTC), books shadow:ladder@bn $2,000 + small:ladder@bn $200, config ladder@bn candidate (not in main_bn until live fills prove the fill model). Quotes one bar late (valid only for minutes opening after the quote), fill at bid if a later 1-min low is 30 bp through, 2 bp maker, exit taker depth-walk 61 min after fill-minute open, 5%/order, <5 open, PERCENT_PRICE band skip; universe = causal top-20 (equals is3 top_universe on 3 checked days). 6 known-answer tests; watchdog heartbeat ladder_tick. Live evidence accrues from today.

forms.what: risk: margin locked by resting orders, 2025-10-10 replay minute by minute, exchange outage during a cascade, max loss per day cap
forms.result: 1,597 kept one-bar-late fills, minute paths (exit check exact). Worst MARK (open positions at minute low, start-equity units) -17.4% (2025-10-10), -16.9% (2024-01-03), -12.3% (2021-09-07) vs booked worst day -4.6%, mdd -2.9%: below the 25% kill, so 5%/order stays (10% would be -34.8%). Gross up to 95% (19 same-minute fills, 2023-12-11); resting bids up to 100% notional -> real money needs cross margin >= 2x. Outage proxy (exit 3 h late on 79 cascade days, 814 fills): SR 2.05 vs 2.14, h240 better than h60 on those days. Daily loss cap 2/3/5%: no effect (SR 2.13; damage arrives in one batch minute). Size is the risk lever. 1 run.

forms.what: T1 is short crash insurance (Artemis: 'short convexity'; HOFM: overbetting kills, not being wrong): daily P&L of the ladder vs tsmom / flow shadow returns in the 20 worst weeks, and size from a fractional-Kelly with a worst case of -50% on every simultaneous fill added by hand, vs the 5% rule
forms.result: Not short insurance at the booked level: ladder +11.3% summed over the main_bn mix's (flow/xsmom/blend, bnall 1d, evaluate tag E2d) 20 worst weeks (18/20 >= 0), +3.9% over BTC's 20 worst weeks; weekly corr with mix -0.12, BTC +0.08; worst ladder week -4.1% (2025-10-12). Half-Kelly meaningless (31x of 5%). Pre-set worst case (-50% on every fill of the largest batch, 17) must stay above the 25% kill -> f <= 2.94%: live SIZE cut 0.05 -> 0.029 (kripto/ladder.py, tests pass). Cost: return scales to ~8.4%/yr simple at SR unchanged; side effect: BTC (step 0.001 ~ $60+) no longer fills in the $2,000 shadow. 1 run.

forms.what: T1i_audit: quote min(30 sigma, Binance PERCENT_PRICE band) from exchangeInfo, skip when outside; same-minute fills all taken; size <= 5% (audit: LAB -58% in an hour)
forms.result: applied in E2a/b: fills with 30 sigma deeper than PERCENT_PRICE (1-multiplierDown, today's exchangeInfo; delisted 15%) skipped = 84 of 1,142 k30 fills (60/551 k40, 95/2,889 k20); all same-minute fills taken; 5% per order; frozen k30 h60 s5 SR 2.14 after the cut. Limit: today's bands applied to 2021-26 (historical bands unknown).

items.reason: Engineering of the confirmed T1 ladder; its own confirmation is the live book, not a card. WF OOS SR 1.94 (grid avg 2.19 -> trade frozen T1k30 h60), gate passed, live since 11-23. Minute-mark worst -17% at 5% (2025-10-10); pre-set worst-case rule cut size to 2.9%; loss caps/stops useless, size is the lever; not crash-correlated with the main_bn mix (+11% in its 20 worst weeks). Open until live fills (count, bp/fill vs 116 bp one-bar-late) prove the fill model.
